{"servers":[],"templates":[{"id":"linux-health","priority":0,"script":"export LC_ALL=C
set -eu
first=$(awk '/^cpu / { idle=$5+$6; total=0; for(i=2;i<=9;i++) total+=$i; print total, idle; exit }' /proc/stat)
sleep 1
awk -v first="$first" '/^cpu / { split(first,a," "); idle=$5+$6; total=0; for(i=2;i<=9;i++) total+=$i; delta=total-a[1]; if(delta<=0) exit 1; printf "cpu_percent\t%.2f\t%%\t-\n", 100*(delta-idle+a[2])/delta; exit }' /proc/stat
awk '/^MemTotal:/ {total=$2} /^MemAvailable:/ {available=$2; found=1} END {if(total<=0 || !found) exit 1; printf "memory_percent\t%.2f\t%%\t-\n",100*(total-available)/total}' /proc/meminfo
awk '{printf "load_1m\t%s\tload\t-\n",$1}' /proc/loadavg
awk '{printf "uptime_seconds\t%s\ts\t-\n",$1}' /proc/uptime","fields":[{"name":"cpu_percent","group":"health","type":"number","unit":"%","label":"none","maximum":100},{"name":"memory_percent","group":"health","type":"number","unit":"%","label":"none","maximum":100},{"name":"load_1m","group":"health","type":"number","unit":"load","label":"none"},{"name":"uptime_seconds","group":"health","type":"number","unit":"s","label":"none"}],"metrics":["cpu_percent","memory_percent","load_1m","uptime_seconds"],"panels":[{"metric":"cpu_percent","chart":"trend","unit":"%","maximum":100},{"metric":"memory_percent","chart":"trend","unit":"%","maximum":100},{"metric":"load_1m","chart":"trend","unit":"load"}]},{"id":"linux-filesystems","priority":1,"script":"export LC_ALL=C
set -eu
df -Pk | awk 'NR>1 && $1 !~ /^(tmpfs|devtmpfs)$/ {use=$5; sub(/%$/,"",use); label=$6; for(i=7;i<=NF;i++) label=label " " $i; printf "disk_percent\t%s\t%%\t%s\n",use,label}'","fields":[{"name":"disk_percent","group":"filesystem","type":"number","unit":"%","label":"instance","maximum":100}],"metrics":["disk_percent"],"panels":[{"metric":"disk_percent","chart":"ranking","unit":"%","maximum":100}]},{"id":"linux-capacity","priority":2,"script":"export LC_ALL=C
set -eu
awk '/^MemTotal:/ {total=$2} /^MemAvailable:/ {available=$2; found=1} END {if(total<=0 || !found) exit 1; printf "memory_total_bytes\t%.0f\tB\t-\nmemory_used_bytes\t%.0f\tB\t-\nmemory_available_bytes\t%.0f\tB\t-\n",total*1024,(total-available)*1024,available*1024}' /proc/meminfo
df -Pk | awk 'NR>1 && $1 !~ /^(tmpfs|devtmpfs)$/ {label=$6; for(i=7;i<=NF;i++) label=label " " $i; printf "filesystem_total_bytes\t%.0f\tB\t%s\nfilesystem_used_bytes\t%.0f\tB\t%s\nfilesystem_available_bytes\t%.0f\tB\t%s\n",$2*1024,label,$3*1024,label,$4*1024,label}'","fields":[{"name":"memory_total_bytes","group":"memory","type":"number","unit":"B","label":"none"},{"name":"memory_used_bytes","group":"memory","type":"number","unit":"B","label":"none"},{"name":"memory_available_bytes","group":"memory","type":"number","unit":"B","label":"none"},{"name":"filesystem_total_bytes","group":"filesystem","type":"number","unit":"B","label":"instance"},{"name":"filesystem_used_bytes","group":"filesystem","type":"number","unit":"B","label":"instance"},{"name":"filesystem_available_bytes","group":"filesystem","type":"number","unit":"B","label":"instance"}],"metrics":["memory_total_bytes","memory_used_bytes","memory_available_bytes","filesystem_total_bytes","filesystem_used_bytes","filesystem_available_bytes"],"panels":[{"metric":"memory_used_bytes","chart":"ranking","unit":"B","totalMetric":"memory_total_bytes"},{"metric":"filesystem_used_bytes","chart":"ranking","unit":"B","totalMetric":"filesystem_total_bytes"}]},{"id":"linux-network","priority":3,"script":"export LC_ALL=C
set -eu
printf 'network_boot_id\t%s\ttext\t-\n' "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)"
awk 'NR>2 {split($0,a,":"); name=a[1]; gsub(/ /,"",name); sub(/^[[:space:]]+/,"",a[2]); split(a[2],v,/[[:space:]]+/); printf "network_receive_bytes\t%s\tB\t%s\nnetwork_transmit_bytes\t%s\tB\t%s\n",v[1],name,v[9],name}' /proc/net/dev","fields":[{"name":"network_boot_id","group":"boot","type":"string","unit":"text","label":"none"},{"name":"network_receive_bytes","group":"network","type":"number","unit":"B","label":"instance"},{"name":"network_transmit_bytes","group":"network","type":"number","unit":"B","label":"instance"}],"metrics":["network_boot_id","network_receive_bytes","network_transmit_bytes"],"panels":[{"metric":"network_receive_rate","chart":"trend","unit":"B/s"},{"metric":"network_transmit_rate","chart":"trend","unit":"B/s"}]},{"id":"linux-processes","priority":4,"script":"export LC_ALL=C
set -eu
ps -eo pid=,pcpu=,comm= --sort=-pcpu | awk 'NR<=10 {name=$3; for(i=4;i<=NF;i++) name=name " " $i; printf "cpu_process_percent\t%s\t%%\t%s\ncpu_process_name\t%s\ttext\t%s\n",$2,$1,name,$1}'
ps -eo pid=,pmem=,comm= --sort=-pmem | awk 'NR<=10 {name=$3; for(i=4;i<=NF;i++) name=name " " $i; printf "memory_process_percent\t%s\t%%\t%s\nmemory_process_name\t%s\ttext\t%s\n",$2,$1,name,$1}'","fields":[{"name":"cpu_process_percent","group":"process-cpu","type":"number","unit":"%","label":"instance"},{"name":"cpu_process_name","group":"process-cpu","type":"string","unit":"text","label":"instance"},{"name":"memory_process_percent","group":"process-memory","type":"number","unit":"%","label":"instance","maximum":100},{"name":"memory_process_name","group":"process-memory","type":"string","unit":"text","label":"instance"}],"metrics":["cpu_process_percent","cpu_process_name","memory_process_percent","memory_process_name"],"panels":[{"metric":"cpu_process_percent","chart":"ranking","unit":"%","nameMetric":"cpu_process_name"},{"metric":"memory_process_percent","chart":"ranking","unit":"%","maximum":100,"nameMetric":"memory_process_name"}]}],"intervalMs":60000,"monitors":[]}
